game_title: Function Test Arena – Furrier Lane Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane, a lane of furriers: the sled courier must handle icicle bats while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing icicle bats.
theme: Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane: a lane of furriers
core_gameplay_loop: In Furrier Lane, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing icicle bats. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the ice mill using at most 13 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The ice mill reached with actions_used <= 13.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 13 before the ice mill is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against icicle bats in Furrier Lane.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ice mill reached with actions_used <= 13.
